title: Create and register a remote host
responsibility: Create a disabled host identity or register an existing identity and enable its relay connection.

inputs.name: registerRemoteHost.state
inputs.description: Existing host state; successful registration updates enabled, origin and generation in this object.

inputs.name: registerRemoteHost.name
inputs.description: Computer name sent with the registration.

inputs.name: registerRemoteHost.register
inputs.description: Callback receiving host ID, public key, credential hash and name and returning registration details.

outputs.name: remoteHostIdentity
outputs.description: New disabled state with generated keys, host ID and credential, no origin, generation zero and empty device/revocation lists.

outputs.name: registerRemoteHost
outputs.description: Imported key pair after accepting a matching host ID and valid relay origin.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects invalid relay registration; key generation/import and registration failures also propagate.
